name: ba-bpmn
description: Draw checked BPMN diagrams from a chat: SVG, PNG and a Camunda-importable .bpmn file.

interface.shortDescription: Draw checked BPMN process diagrams from a chat.
interface.longDescription: Describe a business process in plain words. The assistant asks only what is missing, draws a checked swimlane diagram, and after you approve exports an SVG, a PNG and a .bpmn file that opens in Camunda.
defaultPrompt: Draw the process for approving a leave request.
